items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: Well I played in a brass band on a parade but I played, I'm talking about his dance orchestra now. I did some of the feature trumpet for him.

ctx.x: Was that a brass band job or?
Well I played in a brass band on a parade but I played, I'm talking about his dance orchestra now. I did some of the feature trumpet for him.

items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: That's a couple of times he hired me to play second trumpet.

ctx.x: Well I still can't figure out when Celestan fits in. What did he do?

When you played with Celestan I can't figure out how that fits in. Oh I don't, I didn't play with him steady. That's a couple of times he hired me to play second trumpet. I didn't play with Celestan steady. I see. I know what he did. One time I went to Gulfport, Mississippi with him. Played a dance and I went to Bergaloochee one time with him. But not steady playing with him. I had my own band. I see. Who was that guitar man who got poisoned with Jack Kerr? His name was, oh he was a spook. Now what was that guy's…
He might have been sneaking out a lot of back doors too. Oh yeah. And nobody knew about it. So you couldn't figure it out then. Yeah you,

items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1957-multiple
items.q: And I lost one cup with Son of Silestan.

ctx.x: Earl Humphrey had a band with who in it?

He didn't have no band, just make up band for it, or for a gig they called it, you know. The gig was blowing to Earl, and Earl didn't have nobody play, so who, who just went around and picked up some fellas and went play the game, but just for eleven cups, see. And I lost one cup with Son of Silestan. And I played for three, and one, two, I had three, but he had such a big band, see, he had twelve pieces, and I had six pieces.

So that's where we all went. The Tiger Ragnar, did they ever call that play Jack Carey, or? Yeah, they used to say that too. Did they yell that as a break sometime, that play Jack Carey? I mean, the, over the, the.
